'''Asset R-31''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="State" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> R-31 attempted to purchase potentially-incriminating holorecords from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh's]] [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]; however, R-31 and [[Unidentified seller|the seller]] were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Taris while negotiating. The Shroud believed the [[GenoHaradan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] group to be responsible, and the asset's [[Death/Legends|death]] prompted the Shroud to send [[Asset R-10]] to investigate.<ref name="State" />
